watched #VenkyMama : as the title suggests….its Venky’s one man show!!! apart from Venky’s Comedy & Emotional Timing along with Mama-Alludu chemistry there is nothing much to say about the story, dialogues, direction, BGM or Music. The pre climax and Climax episodes test the patience of audience with complete illogical sequences _/\_

only Venky Mama is the saving grace for this otherwise below par film…….
